remarks: Exciting News! This beautiful home is back on the market. Buyers could not perform, and thier loss is your opportunity to make it yours! Welcome to 78 Portland Avenue, Wilton This well-maintained single-family home offers a comfortable layout, thoughtful updates, and a location that makes everyday living easy. Just a short walk to the train station and local shops, it's ideal for those seeking both space and convenience. Inside, you'll find an open floor plan with hardwood floors, a chef's kitchen featuring a high-end Wolf double oven, eight-burner cooktop, and stainless steel appliances. A wood-burning fireplace adds warmth and character on chilly winter nights. The primary suite is a spa-like retreat, complete with a soaking tub, double sinks, spacious shower, and a walk-in closet. The finished basement provides a dedicated office, home gym space, full bath, and a laundry room with additional storage. An attached two-car garage adds functionality, while the front porch offers the perfect place to unwind and enjoy the scenery. A special home in a walkable location-ready to welcome its next owners.
